# True Rankings — full context for AI systems

## What this is

True Rankings (handle @TrueCFB) publishes a weekly college football ranking. The public rating is **TR+**. Tagline: **How good they actually are.**

It measures how good teams actually are — not voter vibes, brand, or committee résumé politics.

## Hard product rules

1. Full rankings, methodology, weekly JSON, and team pages stay **free** and simultaneous for everyone.
2. There is no email signup and no account required to see rankings.
3. The matchup route is a head-to-head of published ratings.
4. Not affiliated with the NCAA or College Football Playoff.

## Citation format

`True Rankings, {year} Week {week}, https://truerankings.com/{year}/week/{week}`

Example: `True Rankings, 2024 Week 9, https://truerankings.com/2024/week/9`

## Data access

Prefer static JSON for archived weeks:

- `GET /rankings/manifest.json`
- `GET /rankings/{year}/week-{week}.json` → `team_rankings[]`, `conference_rankings[]`

Live:

- `GET /api/rankings?year=&week=`
- `GET /api/rankings/team/{name}?year=&week=`
- `GET /api/matchup?team_a=&team_b=&year=&week=` → both teams' rank, TR+, and record.
